notes.title: Devlog #1 - Industrial Town
notes.content:
Just finished a new level for the game that I am calling the "Industrial Town". Whereas the first level was going for a tropical vacation feel, this one I am going for a desolate industrial landscape. This will be the game's second level where the Crab will be tasked with destroying several polluting industries. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40440511/b7b0a73c47e156b5ba7b54955583f37b0eafc233.png[/img]

The town has also been populated with numerous military forces that will do their best to stop the Crab in his mission of destruction:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40440511/22cd705b99a20441dae86360823aaf1eefdc5c63.png[/img]
